summary: The posterior-threshold characterization underlying the power analysis omits a boundary-atom condition. Exact Type I calibration remains supported. Practical density-ratio truncation is outside the exact-shift theorem; two local released-code defects are established without attributing them to historical results.
limitations: Selective static source inspection, no author code executed.
No historical checkpoint or raw benchmark reproduction.
Full repaired Type II theorem not proved; no claim of false benchmark tables.
Novelty and bibliography priority not adjudicated.

problems.claim: Section 2.3 asserts optimal deterministic rule always has strict posterior-threshold form; proof of Theorem 2.2 uses exact posterior tails.
problems.assumptions: X uniform, Y independent fair Bernoulli, continuous approximate score .5+epsilon(2X-1), H identity.
problems.check: Constant posterior makes strict threshold accept all or none; deterministic X<=alpha attains admissible positive power.
problems.result: General characterization false and missing boundary hypothesis in core power derivation; not a numeric falsification under an added exact-quantile assumption.
problems.counterevidence: Would be avoided by suitable posterior atom-free/exact-tail conditions or explicit boundary selection; Type I does not rely on this.
problems.impact: Core Type II derivation invalid at stated generality, Type I and empirical measurements survive.
problems.correction: State exact posterior boundary assumptions or redo analysis with boundary selection. Full repaired bound unverified.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Directly read pp3-4 and p14 proof. The source explicitly allows stochastic Y conditional on question/answer; optimal rule ranges over deterministic measurable classifiers. Only the estimated score is assumed continuous.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: For independent fair Y and X~Uniform[0,1], P0=P1 and eta=.5. Strict thresholds of eta can accept only0 or100%; the feasible rule1{X<=alpha} has poweralpha, while every feasible strict posterior threshold has power0. Continuous score .5+eps(2X-1) satisfies uniform approximation without removing the posterior atom. The proof uses unavailable exact tail masses at alpha and alpha-prime.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: If exact posterior tails are additional assumptions this example falls outside that repaired formulation; they are not supplied by estimated-score continuity. This is a failed characterization/core derivation, not a numeric counterexample under an already repaired theorem. TypeI order-statistic proof remains separate.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Major retained for core power theorem dependency. Exact-tail/atom conditions or explicit boundary selection need a revised risk proof; full bound repair unverified.

problems.claim: Whether the disclosed practical estimated-ratio/percentile-envelope implementation inherits the exact shift guarantee.
problems.location: p.8 §5.4, p.17 C.4 versus p.4 Theorem 3.1.
problems.assumptions: Exact oracle conditional ratios but percentile rather than global envelope; covariate shift attainable with independent Y.
problems.check: Two-stratum source .001,target .09; B=.91/.999 leads to uncorrected source retained law. Probability .904792 of target FPR .09 at nominal .05,delta .01.
problems.result: The counterexample establishes that the exact theorem cannot be transferred. Section5.4 is explicitly empirical and discloses the approximation, so a false empirical assertion or a claimed universal practical guarantee is not established.
problems.counterevidence: Theorem3.1 explicitly assumes a known globally bounded ratio; Section5.4 reports observed error control with disclosed approximations. This admissible empirical reading is retained.
problems.impact: Scope clarification only; universal practical guarantee and historical violation remain unestablished. Does not increase paper severity.
problems.correction: Keep the empirical reading; a stronger guarantee would require ratio-error/truncation analysis, but no demonstrated claim-level correction is imposed.

independent_verification.source_and_assumptions: Read p4 exact known-ratio/global-envelope assumptions and p8 Section5.4 plus p17 C.4. The practical quantile and estimation choices are openly disclosed in an experimental section.
independent_verification.decisive_reasoning: For source mass.001 and target mass.09 on E, oracle ratios90 and.91/.999 give90th-percentile B=.91/.999. Clipping accepts every source sample, so target law is not recovered; missing E in100 draws has probability .999^100. This proves lack of automatic theorem transfer.
independent_verification.alternative_and_dependency: The results paragraph can reasonably refer only to observed Figure4 curves. The finite construction does not contradict those empirical measurements and the exact theorem is valid. The initial Minor characterization overreached the evidence.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Corrected to scope_clarification / Needs Evidence for any claimed general practical guarantee or historical failure. Main assessment stays Major because P1 is independent. No unsupported error claim is retained.
